summary: Iter42 verification of PDF refactor (InvoiceApp.tsx → buildInvoicePdf.ts wiring). All requested frontend flows PASS. The component now imports buildInvoicePdf from ./buildInvoicePdf (line 15) and invokes it from handleDownloadPDF (line 428), preceded by an idempotent invoiceApi.share() call that supplies the shareUrl for the QR. Verified end-to-end: login → editor renders 3-pane layout (invoice-app, invoice-sidebar testids present) → fill client name + save → click toolbar PDF (data-testid='toolbar-pdf') → PDF downloads as INV-001.pdf (153KB, single page) containing client name, business, totals AND bank details (Chase / Admin Account / 111122223333 / 021000021 / Checking / @adminhandle) AND a QR code (text 'Scan to view or pay online' present in last page). Cross-promo modal (data-testid='esign-cross-promo-modal') opens immediately after download; dismissable via 'Maybe later' button (Escape alone does NOT dismiss it — minor UX nit). Re-clicking PDF re-opens the modal — this is INTENTIONAL cross-promo on highest-intent moment (per code comment in InvoiceApp.tsx:431) and matches prior behavior. Row-level PDF in Invoices history works via kebab (data-testid='row-menu-{id}') → 'Download PDF' (data-testid='row-action-download-pdf-{id}') and downloads a valid PDF with totals + bank details. /tools/esign smoke loads cleanly (no Application error, body 14276 chars). No regression vs pre-refactor behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing race (NOT introduced by this refactor): the 80ms setTimeout between handleOpenInvoice() and handleDownloadPDF() is too tight — the row-downloaded PDF shows BILL TO 'Client' (default placeholder) instead of the saved client name ('TEST PDF Client') and lacks the QR code. The line items/amount and bank details still render correctly. Should await the state to settle (e.g., chain via useEffect or pass invoice payload directly to buildInvoicePdf without relying on React state).
Escape key does NOT dismiss the cross-promo modal — only the explicit 'Maybe later' / 'Sign with eSign' buttons close it. Minor UX gap; not a regression.

verifications.2_toolbar_pdf_download: PASS — click [data-testid='toolbar-pdf'] → INV-001.pdf (153,145 bytes) downloaded. pypdf-extracted text shows: invoice number, BILL TO 'TEST PDF Client', items, Subtotal/TOTAL $100.00, full BANK / PAYMENT DETAILS block, and QR caption 'Scan to view or pay online'.
verifications.4_modal_dismissable: PASS — clicking 'Maybe later' dismisses. (Escape does NOT — LOW priority UX nit.)
verifications.5_re_download_modal_reopens_intentionall: PASS — second PDF click downloads another 153KB INV-001.pdf and re-opens the modal. Matches code comment 'Cross-promote eSign after download — highest-intent moment'. NOT spurious — user explicitly triggered new download.
verifications.6_row_level_pdf_via_kebab: PASS (with caveat) — kebab → 'Download PDF' downloads a 7.5KB INV-001.pdf with correct totals + bank details. BILL TO shows default 'Client' instead of the saved client name and QR is missing — caused by pre-existing 80ms setTimeout race in handleRowDownloadPDF (not a refactor regression).
verifications.7_bank_details_auto_filled: PASS — saved default bank_details from /api/invoices/settings (Chase / Admin Account / 111122223333 / 021000021 / Checking / @adminhandle) appear in both PDF flows.
verifications.8_esign_smoke: PASS — /tools/esign loads with full marketing page (Sign Documents Free / No DocuSign / Sign a Document Free) — no Application error, no 500.
verifications.9_refactor_wiring_code_review: PASS — InvoiceApp.tsx line 15 imports buildInvoicePdf; line 415-437 handleDownloadPDF is thin caller (~22 lines) that fetches shareUrl via invoiceApi.share() then awaits buildInvoicePdf({inv, shareUrl}) and calls doc.save(). No inline jsPDF code remains. File is 745 lines as claimed.

action_items: LOW: Fix race in handleRowDownloadPDF (line 339-343 of InvoiceApp.tsx) — replace `setTimeout(()=>handleDownloadPDF(),80)` with explicit invoice fetch and direct buildInvoicePdf({inv: fetched, shareUrl}) call. Currently row-downloaded PDFs may render stale/default client_name and skip QR code (the toolbar flow is unaffected because state is already settled when user clicks).
LOW: Add Escape-key handler to esign-cross-promo-modal for accessibility consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: buildInvoicePdf.ts (179 lines) is a pure function — no React/toast dependencies — good separation. Dynamic imports of jspdf/qrcode/pdf-brand keep initial bundle lean. Returns the jsPDF instance for caller to .save() — correct.
handleDownloadPDF best-effort QR generation: share() is wrapped in try/catch — falls through gracefully if API fails. Good.

handleRowDownloadPDF still uses a fragile setTimeout(80ms). Refactor opportunity: have buildInvoicePdf accept inv directly (it already does) and call it with the freshly-fetched invoice payload without going through React state.
InvoiceApp.tsx now 745 lines (was 894) — improvement, but still candidate for further extraction (toolbar, status mgmt, save/share logic).
Modal close-on-Escape would be a one-line addition in EsignCrossPromoModal — improves a11y.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested flows PASS; 2 LOW-priority pre-existing UX nits — not refactor regressions)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST invoice INV-001 with client 'TEST PDF Client' via Save button. Two pre-existing TEST_PUBROUTE / Test invoices already in history.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Refactor verified working. data-testids confirmed in /tools/invoice: invoice-app, invoice-sidebar, sidebar-new-invoice, toolbar-pdf, client-name, biz-name, inv-number, row-menu-{id}, row-action-edit-{id}, row-action-duplicate-{id}, row-action-resend-{id}, row-action-mark-as-paid-{id}, row-action-download-pdf-{id}, row-action-share-link-{id}, row-action-delete-{id}, esign-cross-promo-modal. The cross-promo modal does NOT close on Escape — use 'Maybe later' button to dismiss. Row PDF flow has a known 80ms timing race that may produce a stale/QR-less PDF; the toolbar flow is solid. Frontend is running production build (next start) — code edits require yarn build + supervisorctl restart frontend.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a bug fix — this iteration verified the refactor that wired buildInvoicePdf.ts into InvoiceApp.tsx. The two LOW findings are pre-existing UX nits not introduced by the refactor: (a) row PDF race due to 80ms setTimeout (fix: await fresh invoice data and pass directly to buildInvoicePdf rather than rely on React state propagation); (b) cross-promo modal not closing on Escape (fix: add onKeyDown Escape handler in EsignCrossPromoModal).
